scope.theorem_A: For every integer n>=2 and every edge e of K_n, ordinary cr(K_n-e)=Z(n)-binom(floor((n-1)/2),2), equivalently the frozen candidate floor product.
scope.corollary_B: For every m>=4 and n>=1, cr(K_m Cartesian P_n) has the frozen Zheng floor formula; P_n has n edges. One application using OWH Corollary 5.1, not a second result.
scope.new_range: Odd complete sizes n>=15; odd path-product base orders m>=13 use the new portion.
